description: We are AVIRA_LunarNav_RELOADED, an innovation-driven team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Led by a software engineer from India with 13+ years of experience in C/C++, embedded systems, algorithms and system architecture, we aim to develop a data-driven Lunar Landing Site Navigator using NASA datasets, AI, 3D visualization and scientific analysis. We welcome global collaborators skilled in astronomy, lunar science, Python, AI/ML, 3D graphics and UI/UX.
